known_differences.description: fsci-odr implements ODRPACK trust-region Levenberg-Marquardt orthogonal distance regression for explicit, implicit, and multi-response models.

threats.description: Poorly scaled explanatory variables x or response y causing trust-region Levenberg-Marquardt step rank deficiency.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-odr/src/lib.rs:441 (run): computes scale-invariant relative parameter and sum-of-squares convergence measures matching ODRPACK.
threats.strict_mode_response: Use scale-free relative convergence criteria and Levenberg-Marquardt damping.

threats.description: Non-positive standard deviations (sx, sy <= 0) or mismatched observation counts between x, y, and weights.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-odr/src/lib.rs:709 (odr): validates observation dimensions, weight positivity, and finite initial beta0 before iteration.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return Err(OdrError) on mismatched lengths or non-positive standard deviations.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject invalid weights or non-finite inputs fail-closed.

threats.description: Non-convergent implicit ODR iterations spinning without bounded iteration cap.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-odr/src/lib.rs:441 (run): enforces maxit iteration cap (default 50) and reports stopreason when reached.
threats.strict_mode_response: Terminate at maxit with info=4 (iteration limit reached) matching ODRPACK.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Enforce maxit bound and return structured OdrOutput.

threats.description: Fixed parameter masks (ifixb / ifixx) or OLS fit_type=2 drifting from SciPy ODR parameter covariance scaling.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-odr/src/lib.rs:141 (with_input_free): zeroes step columns for fixed parameters and reduces fit_type=2 to ordinary least squares.
threats.strict_mode_response: Hold masked parameters constant and compute cov_beta / sd_beta matching SciPy.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Validate mask lengths against beta0 and x dimensions.

fail_closed_policies.input_class: mismatched x and y observation counts

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Return OdrOutput with info=4 and stopreason.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return OdrOutput with info=4 and stopreason.
